description: Low-resolution retro prop. Derived from the look of the current placeholder asset (drillimpact PSX First Person Arms, 512px sheet) -- NOT a ratified project art direction. See docs/architecture/tooling/贴图管线.md section 11.
notes: AO and curvature are still baked: they drive Painter's edge-wear and dirt generators, then get flattened into BaseMap. They are not shipped as separate Unity textures.
No normal map on purpose -- the hardware being imitated had none, and a normal map on a 256px sheet reads as noise.
Filter Mode stays Bilinear rather than Point: Point is a per-material look decision for the art lead, not something the texture pipeline should force on every asset.
